False-positive guard

This paragraph deliberately contains the exact strings a platform uses for its disclosure — "Altered or synthetic content" and «Изменённый или синтетический контент» — as ordinary article text. Nothing on this page may be blocked because of it: disclosure strings are only ever matched inside the disclosure containers a site adapter names.
